patch.summary:
Choose Azure DevOps only if your buying job matches “Azure Repos/Boards/Pipelines — first 5 Basic users free, then $6/user/mo; Basic + Test Pla” rather than Fly.io's shape. Choose Fly.io only if your buying job matches “Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regio” rather than Azure DevOps's shape. Workflow advantage: Azure DevOps leans source-control-devops; Fly.io leans cloud-paas. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Azure DevOps is Azure Repos/Boards/Pipelines — first 5 Basic users free, then $6/user/mo; Basic + Test Plans $52/user/mo; Artifacts 2 GiB free.; Fly.io is Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regions. Support Standard $29/mo is support, not hostin.
- Company-size focus: Azure DevOps (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Fly.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Azure DevOps-leaning source-control-devops vs Fly.io-leaning cloud-paas.
- Researched limits: Azure DevOps — User 6 onwards is $6/user/mo for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround; Fly.io — Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award.

Limitations — Azure DevOps: User 6 onwards is $6/user/mo for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround; Test Plans at $52/user is a QA licence, not something to assign to every developer; Fly.io: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award; Support Standard $29/mo is support — not the hosting floor.

Poor-fit cases: Azure DevOps is a poor fit when that limitation bites: User 6 onwards is $6/user/mo for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround · Fly.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award · Avoid Azure DevOps if you actually need Fly.io's motion (Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-)
